sn35.152:0.3: For What Purpose the Holy Life?
sn35.152:1.1: “Bhikkhus, if wanderers of other sects ask you:
sn35.152:1.2: ‘For what purpose, friends, is the holy life lived under the ascetic Gotama?’—
sn35.152:1.3: being asked thus, you should answer those wanderers thus:
sn35.152:1.4: ‘It is, friends, for the full understanding of suffering that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn35.152:1.5: Then, bhikkhus, if those wanderers ask you:
sn35.152:1.6: ‘What, friends, is that suffering for the full understanding of which the holy life is lived under the ascetic Gotama?’—
sn35.152:1.7: being asked thus, you should answer those wanderers thus:
sn35.152:2.2: it is for the full understanding of this that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.152:2.4: it is for the full understanding of them that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.152:2.9: Whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition—whether pleasant or painful or neither-painful-nor-pleasant—that too is suffering:
sn35.152:2.10: it is for the full understanding of this that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.152:2.14: Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition … that too is suffering:
sn35.152:2.15: it is for the full understanding of this that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.152:2.17: is the suffering for the full understanding of which the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn35.152:2.18: “Being asked thus, bhikkhus, you should answer those wanderers of other sects in such a way.”
